subtitle: Review placements and keep a record of every decision.
adminHint: Uncheck to transfer work during an absence or assign an already approved placement.
empty: There are no placements in this list.
emptyHint: Refresh to check for new placements.
search: Search by code, location or owner
claimHint: You will be responsible for this review. You cannot release it; only an administrator can transfer it with a reason.
transferHint: This transfer will be recorded. Previous decisions will be preserved.
reasonHint: Explain what the owner needs to fix.
transferReason: Explain why the reviewer is changing.
noReviewers: No other eligible reviewers are available for this placement.
noHistory: No decisions have been recorded yet.
oldHistory: Decisions made before Review Hub have no recorded reviewer.
decisionHint: Your name and the date will be recorded with this decision.
readonly: Only the assigned reviewer can record a decision.
withdrawn: The owner withdrew this placement. It cannot be reviewed.
rejectedHint: This review is complete. The owner can make corrections and resubmit it.

errors.REVIEW_FORBIDDEN: You no longer have permission to review. Refresh your session.
errors.REVIEW_ADMIN_REQUIRED: Only administrators can perform this action.
errors.REVIEW_STALE: The placement changed. Close and reopen this review to load the latest information.
errors.REVIEW_ALREADY_ASSIGNED: Another reviewer already claimed this placement. Refresh the list.
errors.REVIEW_NOT_ASSIGNED_TO_YOU: This placement is assigned to someone else. Refresh the list.
errors.REVIEW_WITHDRAWN: This placement was withdrawn and cannot be reviewed.
errors.REVIEW_INVALID_REVIEWER: The selected reviewer is no longer eligible.
errors.REVIEW_OWN_PLACEMENT: You cannot review your own placements.
errors.REVIEW_INVALID_TRANSITION: This action is unavailable for the current status. Refresh the review.
errors.REVIEW_NOT_FOUND: This placement is no longer available.
